cap: After a semen analysis, female infertility is sorted into ovulation, tubes and uterus. Mid-luteal progesterone checks ovulation, and letrozole, an aromatase inhibitor that lowers estrogen feedback so FSH rises, is first-line in PCOS; clomiphene and gonadotropins carry their own risks, including visual symptoms and ovarian hyperstimulation. Hysterosalpingography separates patent tubes from a hydrosalpinx, which is treated with in vitro fertilization.
